crop.notes: Sporting column with two dispatches; the first ('Tom Allen's Challenge Accepted') is about Allen, the second is a Chicago trotting match.

title.suggested: Joe Coburn Accepts Tom Allen's Challenge

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican printed a New York dispatch saying Joe Coburn would fight Tom Allen in West Virginia or Canada in four months, for $2,500 to $5,000.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, Friday, October 17, 1873'. Not yet the St. Louis Republic (1888).

facts.fact: Joe Coburn said he would fight Allen in West Virginia or Canada in four months for $2,500 to $5,000

notes: No stakes were deposited; the current title is wrong. Article 487 reports this dispatch was contradicted the next day by another saying Coburn would decline all challenges, hence medium confidence.
